Whipped cotton candy infused cake, colorful pink & lavender cream swirls, complete with magical star dust glitter and cotton candy cloud on top.

atts.title: Baking Happiness with Love & Sprinkles
atts.subtitle: Pinky Bites was founded in 2026 by Chef Lily and a dreamy team of pastry creators. Our simple dream was to bake cupcakes that didn't just taste heavenly, but felt like a cheerful hug on a sunny afternoon.
atts.heading: h2

atts.text: We sourced organic pasture butter, fresh strawberries, and premium vanilla pods, combining them with a touch of pastel rainbow magic. Every piece is baked to whimsical perfection, making sure they spark real childlike smiles.

atts.title: Natural Ingredients
atts.content:
🌱

No high fructose corn syrup or artificial preservatives.

atts.title: Crafted with Magic
atts.content:
✨

Intricately hand-decorated with sparkling candy charms.
